item.title: SimpleHelp OIDC Authentication Bypass via Unverified JWT Signature (CVE-2026-48558)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — web · CVE-2026-48558. Status: Weaponized — forges valid privileged sessions with no credentials. Affects: SimpleHelp — remote support / RMM (remote monitoring and management) platform, OIDC authentication flow. Tags: simplehelp, rmm, oidc, jwt, alg-none, cwe-347, authentication-bypass, unauthenticated, remote, kev, actively-exploited, ransomware.
